name: Coconut Aminos
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally fermented and contains minimal FODMAPs. Use in moderation as part of overall meal planning.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts (1 teaspoon) to test tolerance
Check ingredient labels for added garlic or onion powder
Store in refrigerator after opening for best quality
Shake well before use as natural separation may occur
nutritionalHighlights: Lower sodium than traditional soy sauce
Contains amino acids from coconut sap
